text: AI is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, computers can create art, compose music and even write stories. Some people are excited about this, while others are worried. They believe that true creativity comes from human feelings and experiences, which machines cannot understand. AI can copy styles and produce new ideas quickly, but it does not feel emotions. Human creativity is personal and often reflects our lives. Perhaps the best result is when people and AI work together. Artists can use AI as a tool to explore new ideas, while still adding their own imagination and emotions.
